Your body doesn't look small because you lack muscle.
The real reason is forward head posture. Your neck has drifted forward.
It rounds your shoulders, makes you look shorter, and starts the neck pain.
Don't believe it? Stand with your back flat against a wall, right now.
If your head doesn't touch the wall, you're one of the millions who spend all day bent over their phone.
Every fifteen degrees your head tilts forward adds about twelve kilos of load on your neck.
But fixing it is simple. Fifteen days, five minutes a day, just these four moves.
One. Chin tucks. Pull your chin in and your head straight back. Ten reps.
Two. Cobra stretch. Chest up, shoulders back, hold for twenty seconds.
Three. Hip flexor stretch. Push your hips forward, thirty seconds each side.
Four. Glute bridge. Drive up, squeeze your glutes, fifteen reps.
Without a plan, your posture never gets fixed.
